0022600210.text: The Warriors (7-3, on a seven-game winning streak and 5-1 at home) host the Pelicans (4-5, coming off a loss) in the Warriors' 11th game of the season, with Golden State 2nd in the Pacific, 1 game back, and New Orleans 5th in the Southwest, 3.5 games back. Golden State will be without Jimmy Butler III (out, knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (out, illness), and Moses Moody (out, knee surgery), while Gui Santos is day-to-day with knee tendinitis and is a game-time decision; New Orleans is without Yves Missi (out, knee bruise). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Warriors won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, though their most recent meeting was a 113-109 loss in New Orleans on February 24.
